title: Three file reads report an os error without the path
body:
A missing query file gives `failed to open query file: nope.fa`. Three other reads pass the os error up with a bare `?`, so the message names no file:

| Site | Input | What the user sees |
|---|---|---|
| `Seeds::from_path`, `File::open(path)?` | `--seeds` missing, or a directory | `error: No such file or directory (os error 2)`, `error: Is a directory (os error 21)` |
| `guess_query_format`, `read_line(..)?`, in nail/src/util.rs | query path is a directory; a non-UTF-8 first line | `error: Is a directory (os error 21)`; `error: stream did not contain valid UTF-8` |
| nail/src/search.rs, `File::open(positional_seeds_path(args)?)?`, before nail rewrites `--seeds-out` with names | an unreadable intermediate seeds file | not run |

The input survey on nail-d551f7 ran the first two rows against the release binary and read the third from the code.

## Proposal

Wrap each with `.with_context` naming the path, as `guess_query_format_from_query_file` does for its `File::open`.
